cases.name: kpi_total_pax
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(f.pax) AS "pax"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
WHERE dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')

cases.name: pax_by_fy
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_period.fy AS "fy",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
JOIN dim_period ON f.period_key = dim_period.period_key
WHERE dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_period.fy
ORDER BY dim_period.fy

cases.name: monthly_timeline_domestic
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_period.period AS "period",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax",
       100.0 * SUM(f.pax_km_million) / NULLIF(SUM(f.ask_million), 0) AS "pax_load_factor"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
JOIN dim_period ON f.period_key = dim_period.period_key
JOIN dim_segment ON f.segment_key = dim_segment.segment_key
WHERE dim_segment.segment IN ('Domestic')
  AND dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_period.period
ORDER BY dim_period.period

cases.name: top5_airlines_by_month
cases.sql:
WITH top_n AS (
SELECT dim_airline.airline AS v
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
JOIN dim_period ON f.period_key = dim_period.period_key
WHERE dim_period.fy IN ('2018-19')
  AND dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_airline.airline
ORDER BY SUM(f.pax) DESC NULLS LAST, v
LIMIT 5
)
SELECT dim_period.month_name AS "month",
       dim_airline.airline AS "airline",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
JOIN dim_period ON f.period_key = dim_period.period_key
WHERE dim_period.fy IN ('2018-19')
  AND dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
  AND dim_airline.airline IN (SELECT v FROM top_n)
GROUP BY dim_period.month_name, dim_airline.airline, dim_period.fy_month_num
ORDER BY dim_period.fy_month_num, dim_airline.airline

cases.name: sorted_limited
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_airline.airline AS "airline",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax",
       SUM(f.pax) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.departures), 0) AS "pax_per_departure"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
WHERE dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_airline.airline
ORDER BY "pax" DESC NULLS LAST, dim_airline.airline
LIMIT 10

cases.name: aggregates_only_override
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_airline.airline AS "airline",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
WHERE dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Aggregate')
GROUP BY dim_airline.airline
ORDER BY dim_airline.airline

cases.name: date_between
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_period.period AS "period",
       SUM(f.departures) AS "departures"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
JOIN dim_period ON f.period_key = dim_period.period_key
WHERE dim_period.period BETWEEN DATE '2017-04-01' AND DATE '2018-03-01'
  AND dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_period.period
ORDER BY dim_period.period

cases.name: quote_escaping
cases.sql:
SELECT dim_airline.airline AS "airline",
       SUM(f.pax) AS "pax"
FROM fact_airline_monthly AS f
JOIN dim_airline ON f.airline_key = dim_airline.airline_key
WHERE dim_airline.airline NOT IN ('O''Hare Air', 'A')
  AND dim_airline.airline_type IN ('Airline')
GROUP BY dim_airline.airline
ORDER BY dim_airline.airline
